fit: One Gauss-Newton step at originalA; fit only live teacher coefficient columns0,2 and preserve dead columns1,3; full1024 current states, all14 layers
normal_equations: Per-network G_j and b_j average equally over14layers and1024rows; average G,b over included networks; solve (G + .1*trace(G)/64*I) deltaA=b; apply .5*deltaA
final_constants: Round proposedA tofloat32 before full-fit teacher evaluation
gate: Mean four-networkLOO relative LIVE coefficient MSE <=-1%,>=3/4 improved, LIVE coefficientRMS step<=10% of baseline LIVE coefficientRMS on all training/LOO blocks; no tuning or native launch after reject
reason: Static source consumer correction before any fit outcome was read: live _bd_update slices coefficients[:3] and overwrites channel1 with fixed _BD_J1_PHYS; channel3 discarded. Same independent ridge/damping and LOO gates; no data-based tuning.
